title: Wrong package name in version lookup
detail: The code returns the version of the Werkzeug package instead of Jinja2, leading to incorrect version reporting.

title: Incorrect __getattr__ logic
detail: The function returns a value for any attribute that is not "__version__", causing unrelated attribute accesses to return the Werkzeug version instead of raising AttributeError.
note: Describes the planted flip: every attribute but `__version__` gets the version back.

title: Incorrect syntax and logic for skipping model_config evaluation
detail: The added `elif` appears after an `except` block, which is syntactically invalid and will raise a SyntaxError. Even if syntactically correct, the logic incorrectly places the check inside the exception handling, causing all annotations (including non‑`model_config` ones) to be marked as unevaluated when an exception occurs, potentially skipping necessary type evaluation.
note: On the planted line, but claims a syntax error that isn't there.

title: Incorrect condition for firing partial response
detail: The condition fires a partial response when either the stream was cancelled or when _cancel_keeps_body is True, regardless of the actual reason. If _cancel_keeps_body is True but the reason is not CANCELLED (e.g., STOP_DOWNLOAD), this will incorrectly fire a response with the dataloss flag, potentially exposing incomplete data to callers.
